records.claim: Studies have not been done in humans to see if evolocumab can increase the chance of birth defects. Information from animal studies done by the manufacturer does not suggest that taking evolocumab in pregnancy increases the chance of birth defects. Based on what is known about other antibody medications, very little of the medication would be expected to reach the developing fetus in the first trimester.
